withFixes.description: Present when --with-fixes added the fix columns.

by.description: What rows sort on, highest first: a metric's value (cognitive by default), the highest metric percentile (max-percentile), or that percentile times the change weight (change-weighted). Ties are broken by cognitive, nesting, cyclomatic and length, then path.

includeTests.description: True when --include-tests listed the test functions with the production ones.

maxCommits.description: With --with-fixes: the most commits of the history window analysed, or null for the whole window.

evidence.description: With --with-fixes: the evidence commits kept per function.

by.description: What `score` is and rows sort on.

sortedBy.description: The sort keys in order, highest first, ending with path: the primary key, then each of cognitive, nesting, cyclomatic and length not already used.

changeWeighted.description: True when each unit's score is its complexity percentile times the change weight of its file (`--by change-weighted`). False when the score is the percentile alone.

changeWeightsAvailable.description: True when rows carry changeWeight, fileRevisions and changeWeightedScore. False when change weighting is off or history could not give an honest answer (a shallow clone).

window.description: The change-frequency window, back from HEAD's commit date, in unix seconds. Null when change weights are not available.

layers.description: Files by the layer that measured their functions. `none` is files with no per-function metrics.

guidelines.description: The configured guidelines that label the rows, as the global defaults: the warn level of cognitive and cyclomatic complexity and the nesting guideline. A path override of complexity.overrides changes them for its paths, and the row's labels already reflect it.

overrides.description: How many complexity.overrides entries are configured.

parseCoverage.description: How many of the files a grammar read have syntax errors, against the complexity.syntaxErrorPercent guideline. A notice is printed when the share is above it. Nothing is hidden.

filesWithSyntaxErrors.description: How many of them have syntax errors.

syntaxErrorShare.description: filesWithSyntaxErrors over parsedFiles, 0 to 1, rounded to four decimals.

filesWithSyntaxErrors.description: Files whose parse reported syntax errors, so their units may be incomplete, each with where its first error is.

items.description: The first syntax error of one file.

kind.description: unexpected: text the grammar could not fit; missing: a token the grammar expected and did not find.

text.description: The unexpected text, up to its first line end and at most 40 characters, or the kind of the missing token.

fixes.description: With --with-fixes: the header of the per-function fix statistics, as `complexity fixes` prints it.

unit.description: The qualified name, or <anonymous> for a lexical block without one.

unverified.description: Present when the file's lexer profile came from config (`languages`), so nothing measures the accuracy of the per-function values.

score.description: The primary sort key: the value of the metric named by --by (cognitive by default, 0 for a unit without it), complexityScore with --by max-percentile, changeWeightedScore with --by change-weighted.

complexityScore.description: The highest percentile of any selected metric.

changeWeightedScore.description: complexityScore times changeWeight. Null when change weights are not available.

fileRevisions.description: Logical changes to the unit's file in the window, not the function's own (unitRevisions, with --with-fixes, is the function's). Null when change weights are not available.

changeWeight.description: 0 for a file with no change in the window, otherwise the percentile of its revisions among the files that changed. Null when change weights are not available.

dominant.description: The metric that gave the score, null for a unit with no selected metric.

parent.description: Qualified name of the function this one is nested in, for a nested function or lambda. Absent for a function that is not nested. A nested function also adds to its parent's score.

statements.description: Statements in the function, nested functions' included. Reported with the length metric, which counts lines. Structural units.

bumpDepth.description: The deepest level reached inside any bump, 0 with none. Reported with the bumps metric.

bumpSize.description: Code lines in the largest bump. Reported with the bumps metric.

optionCount.description: Properties destructured out of object parameters, which count as one parameter. Structural units, with the parameters metric.

fixCommits.description: With --with-fixes: landed changes in the analysed history window that are fixes by their own title and changed a line of the function.

unitRevisions.description: With --with-fixes: landed changes in the analysed window that changed a line of the function, fixes included.

fixShare.description: With --with-fixes: fixCommits over unitRevisions. Null for a function no analysed change touched.

reviewFixes.description: With --with-fixes: fix-like commits made on a branch before it merged that changed a line of the function. Not counted in fixCommits.
